about: Brovary: from panel blocks to cottages on the left bank

Brovary is a large town on the left bank with very varied housing: Soviet nine-storey panel blocks, new complexes, a private sector and cottage communities along the Chernihiv highway. Older flats typically need full replacement of services and levelled walls; new builds need renovation from scratch.

There are also many production sites, warehouses and offices, so besides homes we do [turnkey office renovation](/en/office-renovation) from $350 per m² and [commercial premises](/en/commercial-renovation), with invoices for companies.

In Brovary panel-block flats the designer first looks for space: where to build in wardrobes, how to enlarge the bathroom at the expense of the corridor, whether the kitchen can be joined with a room. For houses — floor plans, a terrace and a boiler room. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate resale apartments with full replacement of wiring and plumbing — see [major apartment renovation](/en/major-renovation) — as well as new builds and houses. Plots in Brovary and nearby Krasylivka, Trebukhiv and Kniazhychi are usually flat, so a house can be planned freely: single-storey with a terrace or two storeys.

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.

faq: Do you work with panel buildings?
Yes. In panel buildings we do not touch load-bearing walls, and replanning stays within what the structure allows.
How much does renovation in Brovary cost?
From $550 per m² for works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are separate, per estimate.
Do you do offices and commercial premises in Brovary?
Offices from $350 per m² (works and rough materials); other commercial premises per estimate. For companies registered in Ukraine — invoices with or without VAT, individually.
